assets.mobile/art/immortals/ruined-gate.webp: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW original environment background asset for an existing portrait Chinese dark-fantasy 2D action game, tall aspect ratio 2:3. The ruined Kunlun mountain gate courtyard at blue-gray dusk, bleak and numinous. Ancient Chinese timber gate, broken upturned black roof, broken temple pillars, moss, cliff gorges and twisted pines disappearing into fog. Composition: upper 45% architectural depth with gate framed in the center and a hint of thin overcast cold sky; entire lower 55% is contiguous luminous charcoal-gray FLAT worn flagstone combat ground, seen in perspective from slightly above, very open with no walls, props, steps or obstacles; foreground stays clear for overlay 2D characters. Stone floor is midtone dusty ash-gray with sparse wet veins and persistent contrast, not jet black; keep good midtone and cool reflected light on the floor. Restrict ancient dark vermilion scraps and warm incense lights to side edges. Landscape painting spatial layering, physically rendered stone and timber, weathered soot, cinematic, nuanced low saturation, volumetric cold mist in the distance. Ancient China, no European imagery. No people, monsters, UI, writing, watermark, borders or insignia.
